title: JFLCC Mission Video (Short Version)
description: U.S. Army North, as the Joint Force Land Component Command (JFLCC) at Fort Sam Houston, Texas, works alongside Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) to coordinate and provide support where help is needed. U.S. Northern Command, through U.S. Army North, remains committed to providing flexible Department of Defense support to the Federal Emergency Management Agency for the COVID-19 response. (U.S. Army video by Sgt. John Onuoha, 24th Theater Public Affairs Support Element / Released)
